description: This file defines a mock dataset of quiz objects for a front-end application, including quiz metadata, questions, and options, structured as a static in-memory list of `QuizCatalog` instances. It provides sample data for various categories like History, Science, Math, AI/ML, and more, and includes utility methods to retrieve quizzes by ID.

classes.name: MockQuizzesData
classes.description: Provides a static list of quiz data used as mock content for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: MockQuizzesUtils
classes.description: Contains utility methods for accessing mock quiz data, such as finding a quiz by its ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a quiz by its ID within the mock dataset.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Utility method that similarly retrieves a quiz by ID from the mock dataset.
